legislation.notes: Public Act 26-127 Sec. 9. 'Portable solar generation device' has a maximum POWER OUTPUT of not more than 1,200 watts, connects through a standard 120-volt AC outlet behind the customer's meter, and must meet the State Building Code, NEC (NFPA-70), IEEE 1547 and UL 1741. One device per meter. Sec. 9(a)(9) requires a consumer warning that generation exceeding on-site consumption is CHARGED TO THE CUSTOMER AS USAGE unless the customer has a net-metering meter. Does not exempt the device from the State Building Code, Fire Safety Code, State Fire Prevention Code or local ordinance.

watt_tiers.effect: Exempt from interconnection-agreement requirements imposed by PURA; the utility may not require approval, charge a fee, or demand extra controls. One device per meter.
